During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the export company [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] maintained a '''showroom''' in [[Hreas Port City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lenthalis]]. There, customers could floor-test merchandise offered in the company's [[Datalog/Legends|datalog]], ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="GFT" />
